name: layer
title: layer family + parts factory
description: The backdrop + panel family — backdrop, panel, header, body, footer, title, description. Zero variants. The backdrop uses bg-scrim (outside the palette contract — a scrim is not a role). title/description carry no typography (Text through render). Plus createLayerParts(P): a factory that takes a Base UI overlay namespace (Dialog or AlertDialog) and returns the styled wrappers. Shared by dialog, alert-dialog and drawer.
